g.text: Virtual switch VS1 · shared network 10.6.69.x, DHCP · hosts find each other with mDNS (.local names)

svg.text: Local proxy · nginx to Gunicorn on 127.0.0.1:8000
MariaDB 3306 · app to database, node1 only
SSH 22 · Ansible from the control node
SSH 22 · git push and pull to GitHub
Image build and clone · Packer, create-vms.ps1
Tiers 1 and 2 share keat-node1, tier 3 is on keat-node2. Management hosts build and configure the tiers but serve no requests.
ufw on node1 and node2 denies all other incoming traffic. Gunicorn listens on 127.0.0.1 only, so port 8000 is closed to the network.
